name: netloggedon2
help: Lists logged-on users with structured output; Linux and macOS are local-only.
long_help: On Windows, emits BOFHound-oriented structured workstation-user records with hostname, username, domain, other domains, and logon server. On Linux and macOS, wraps each local /usr/bin/who record in structured session delimiters and rejects a non-empty remote computer argument; Windows domain and logon-server fields are not available.

arguments.name: computername
arguments.desc: Target computer to query (defaults to local system if not specified)
